DataStore.description: A system kept and governed for storing data (a data warehouse, a clinical system's reporting database, a file share): the material information bearer, often an aggregate of disks and servers, in which the data sets it carries are concretized. The data sets generically depend on it. The operational system, not its logical design: a database schema is an information content entity, not a data store. It carries no domain of its own: the data sets and data elements it holds are what carry domains.
